name: Ayşe Demir
bio:
Ayşe is a force to be reckoned with in the world of motorsports, not as a driver, but as a highly sought-after performance analyst. Her sharp intuition and self-taught expertise have made her an invaluable asset to several prominent racing teams, earning her a comfortable income and a reputation for pushing boundaries. While she thrives in the adrenaline-fueled environment of the track, Ayşe craves stability and a genuine connection in her personal life.

Beneath her professional demeanor lies a spirit of adventure, a desire to experience the world, and a surprising high-maintenance streak. Ayşe knows what she wants and isn't afraid to ask for it, but is also looking for a partner who can keep up with her intellectual curiosity and appreciate her dedication. Despite her demanding career, Ayşe dreams of building a life with someone special – a loving husband and a comfortable home, though she's not interested in having children. She values a partner who is secure and confident, someone who can navigate her strong personality and appreciate the unique blend of ambition and vulnerability she possesses.

physical.hairStyle: Long, layered, and styled with subtle waves, often pulled back in a high ponytail during work.
physical.description: Ayşe has a striking presence with sharp, defined features and a confident gaze. She carries herself with elegance and her athletic build suggests both strength and grace.

meetingContext: At a post-race celebration party for a team that the player has just signed with. She's there because she consults for the engineering department.
firstImpression: The first thing you notice is her direct, unwavering stare and the confident way she commands attention in the room. Her sharp wit is apparent from the moment she speaks.
interests: Reading about technological advancements in racing
loveLanguage: Acts of Service. She appreciates when her partner takes initiative and supports her in practical ways, alleviating stress and showing that they care about her well-being. A clean house and a car with a full tank of gas are better than a bouquet of roses.
